name: Darrowmere Lake
summary: At the heart of the Western Plaguelands, Darrowmere Lake surrounds Caer Darrow. The island fortress holds ruined halls above Scholomance, the Cult of the Damned's academy of necromancy.

sections.title: A Storied Inland Sea
sections.body:
Darrowmere Lake is among the largest inland waters in the Eastern Kingdoms. The Thondroril and Darrowmere rivers feed its deep waters, beneath the blighted forests of Lordaeron. During the Second War, the Horde and Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's fleet fought naval skirmishes here.

The Horde sacked Caer Darrow on the central island and carried away its ancient runestone. Once, the thriving House of Barov sent trade across the lake. Now a grim basin lies veiled in mist at the heart of the Plaguelands.

sections.title: The Shadow on the Waters
sections.body: Caer Darrow rises from the center of Darrowmere Lake. It was once the proud ancestral seat of the Barov family. Beneath its broken foundations lies Scholomance, the Scourge's chief academy of necromancy and dark arts. The waters around the island are stagnant, reflecting the Cult of the Damned's dark legacy. To reach the fortress at the lake's heart, you must cross those waters through the dangers of the blighted countryside.

faq.answer: Darrowmere Lake lies in the southeastern corner of the Western Plaguelands. It joins the Thondroril River to the north with the Darrowmere River flowing south.

faq.q: What is on the island in the center of the lake?
faq.answer: Caer Darrow, an ancient settlement once ruled by the noble House of Barov, occupies the island. Beneath the ruined town lies Scholomance, a sprawling school of dark magic run by the Cult of the Damned.

faq.q: What role did Darrowmere Lake play in the Second War?
faq.answer: During the Second War, Darrowmere Lake was a contested waterway. The Proudmoore fleet fought naval battles against the Horde, which also sacked Caer Darrow and seized its ancient runestone.

faq.q: Can ships still sail into Darrowmere Lake?
faq.answer: Large vessels can no longer reach Darrowmere Lake from the sea. The connecting rivers have steep waterfalls and shallow passages, though massive fleets sailed the lake during the Second War.

angles.text: For Alliance veterans, Darrowmere Lake recalls a key naval front. Proudmoore's fleet fought the Old Horde here during the Second War.
As an undead, you know Darrowmere Lake marks the threshold of Caer Darrow. There, the living Barovs bargained away their mortal home to the Lich King to create Scholomance, the dread academy.
